Send the code below to your bot in Telegram
Checking your bot token with Telegram…
Send text or pictures to your own Telegram bot and Aira gets the work done on this phone, then sends the result back to the same chat. No computer or separate server needed.

1. In Telegram, open @BotFather and send /newbot.
2. Pick a name and a username ending in “bot”.
3. BotFather replies with a token like 123456:ABC… Copy it and paste it below.
4. Tap Connect, then send your bot the 6-digit code Aira shows.
That doesn’t look like a bot token. It should look like 123456789:ABCdef… Copy it again from @BotFather.
Couldn’t connect to the bot. Check the token and your internet connection, then try again.
No code arrived within 15 minutes. Tap Connect to get a new code.
The change couldn’t be saved. Try again.
Send this code to your bot
Open %1$s in Telegram and send this code, or tap the button below. Only the person who sends the code can give Aira tasks. Don’t share it.
Linked to Aira. Send me a task, like “check my battery level”.
When off, Aira stops reading new messages
Allow Telegram tasks to wake and unlock
Only tasks from your own linked Telegram chat can try to wake and unlock this phone.

Off by default; linking again turns it off. First enable “%3$s” in “%1$s › %2$s” and save your lock-screen PIN or password there, if you use one. This switch does not change that permission or use anything sent through Telegram.

The Telegram task couldn’t wake or unlock the phone. Unlock it yourself, or check the wake and unlock switch in Aira’s Telegram settings, plus remote unlock and saved credentials in Settings › Connect a computer.
Only you, in a private chat
Aira will stop reading your bot’s messages, remove the saved token from this phone, and turn off unlocking for Telegram tasks.
Payment confirmations and taking over the phone
Voice notes, files, groups and more than one person

Aira has no server of its own, but needs an internet connection. Messages pass through Telegram; cloud models use your existing network settings. The bot token is encrypted with Android Keystore and kept only on this phone.
Aira could not receive the pictures, so this message did not start a task. Check the connection and resend up to 8 pictures, at most 10 MB each.
